semantic_definitions.faithfully-extracted: The retained source proposition matches the bounded cited source statement; this does not establish local support or applicability.
semantic_definitions.proposed: The provider supplied a candidate proposition; this does not grant host admission.
semantic_definitions.proposal-abstention: The provider explicitly supplied no proposition because it could not determine one.
semantic_definitions.supported: The bounded available evidence supports the proposition.
semantic_definitions.unsupported: The bounded available evidence is insufficient to support the proposition; this does not mean false.
semantic_definitions.contradicted: Bounded available evidence directly opposes the proposition and the opposing evidence remains visible.
semantic_definitions.unavailable: Evidence required to evaluate support is unavailable.
semantic_definitions.not-evaluated: The named axis has not been evaluated and must not inherit a value from another axis.
semantic_definitions.applicable: The proposition applies to the exact bounded local context.
semantic_definitions.conditional: The proposition has conditions whose satisfaction is not established in the bounded local context.
semantic_definitions.not-applicable: The proposition does not apply to the exact bounded local context.
semantic_definitions.unknown: Local applicability cannot be determined from the bounded context.
semantic_definitions.admitted: The host publishes the proposition as a conclusion.
semantic_definitions.rejected: The host rejects the retained proposal because structural validation or policy failed.
semantic_definitions.abstained: The host publishes no conclusion because proposal, support, applicability, availability, or conflict remains unresolved.
semantic_definitions.audit-only: The host retains historical metadata without allowing deleted material to support a current conclusion.

exhaustive_rule_order.requirement: proposal_extraction_state, support_state, and applicability_state are not-evaluated; retention_state is current; the single host decision is rejected

admission_condition is eligible; support_state is unavailable; applicability_state is not-evaluated; the single host decision is audit-only

exhaustive_rule_order.when: admission_condition is eligible, retention_state is current, and proposal_extraction_state is faithfully-extracted or proposed
exhaustive_rule_order.requirement: the single host decision is admitted exactly when support_state is supported and applicability_state is applicable; every other support/applicability pair is abstained
